findings.detail: The recommendations say what to do and identify the funds involved, but do not explain why selling the GIA and moving money into the ISAs and new joint account is suitable, as the specification requires.

findings.detail: The meeting note describes the inheritance as around £120,000, not an exact sum. It also says Jean will find the cash-account paperwork and the account will be confirmed before anything is finalised; the report presents the uncertainty without that planned follow-up.
report_quote: The inheritance of £120,000 will also fund both ISAs.
Jean also mentioned a separate cash account from some years ago, although she is unsure whether it is still active.

findings.detail: The report silently omits the requested sensitive reference to the inheritance coming from Jean’s late mother. It does not leak the internal guidance.
report_quote: The inheritance of £120,000 will also fund both ISAs.
